messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Is Shiny licensed the same as RStudio itself (i.e. AGPLv3)?
parts:
Thanks for the feedback!

The Shiny package itself is licensed as GPL-3. https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/shiny/index.html
Shiny Server Open Source is licensed as AGPL-3. https://www.rstudio.com/products/shiny/download-server/

Hope that helps.
